description: Privately check a received file against a template, plain-word requirements (need), explicit criteria, a saved contract, a check pack, or a saved report_token (adds a rerun delta). A check_pack_slug without check_pack_version uses the version pinned by bounty_id when supplied, otherwise the current version. Returns pass, fail, or could_not_verify for each declared check. A failed report offers rework.api (the bounty_post body for a rework bounty) and, while held payments are on, settlement (the settlement create body that holds payment until a delivery passes the same checks). Nothing is stored unless save is true, which returns report_url. Each caller gets 20 free checks a month of up to 500 rows each; beyond that the call answers 402 with payable terms when paid checks are available.

bounty_id.description: Your own bounty: runs its pinned checks. Or optional context for check_pack_slug.

check_pack_slug.description: Use criteria from a public check pack.

check_pack_version.description: Pack version to use. Omit to use the version pinned by bounty_id, or the current version when bounty_id is absent.

content.description: Delivery content as UTF-8 text or base64. The whole JSON-RPC request must be at most 4.4 MB on the hosted server, so a base64 file can be up to 3 MB decoded; larger uploads are rejected with HTTP 413.

contract_id.description: Accepted bounty id from your saved contract library; requires Bearer authentication on the MCP connection.

criteria.description: Explicit machine checks returned by an earlier check.

need.description: Acceptance criteria in plain words, drafted into checks the same way as the website, from these words and the delivery's column names only. The response lists the checks that ran; send them as criteria to repeat them exactly.

report_token.description: Reuse the saved criteria structure and origin. Supply source_context again for source-dependent checks.

save.description: Opt in to a shareable, re-runnable report.

source_context.description: Source URLs, glossary, rubric, or reference sample. Required by rubric agreement and saved glossary reruns.

name: check_received_work
title: Check work you received
